summary: PNA <-> GEM linkage bug fix verified end-to-end on the preview environment. All 3 fixes work: (1) PNA modal closes BEFORE navigation (no stacked overlay); (2) URL uses correct `?id=` query param (not legacy `goal_id`); (3) GEM Goal page is pre-populated with title, description, life_area (Health), and the matching Goal Type chip is highlighted for all three PNA categories (Problem -> red Problem chip, Need -> amber Need chip, Aspiration -> green Aspiration chip). Backend round-trip for `goal_type` in {problem,need,aspiration} works correctly. Phase 5 'Linked SMART Goal' section still renders at the bottom of the GEM Goal page (no regression). IMPORTANT: Metro bundler was serving a STALE bundle before testing; an `expo` supervisor restart was required to pick up the new pna.tsx/gem-goal.tsx code -- main agent should keep this in mind for future iterations or after large source rewrites.

action_items: Migrate expo-av usage to expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video) before SDK 54 — unrelated to current fix but flagged per Expo deprecation policy.

When applying frontend source-level fixes in future iterations, do a `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` after writing files to ensure Metro serves the fresh bundle (otherwise testing the bug fix will incorrectly show the bug still occurring).
critical_code_review_comments: pna.tsx (lines 162-169) `openLinkedGoal` correctly closes the modal then router.push with `id=` — looks good.
pna.tsx (line 143) `goalType = form.category` correctly passes canonical problem|need|aspiration — good.
gem-goal.tsx (lines 71-78) `typeMap` covers legacy values (project->problem, task->problem, objective->need, long_term->aspiration, short_term->need) — backward-compatible mapping is correct.
gem-goal.tsx line 29 reads `useLocalSearchParams()` for `id` — matches the URL produced by pna.tsx.

Note: PNA modal `openLinkedGoal` uses setTimeout(80) between setShowModal(false) and router.push — this works on web but may want a `requestAnimationFrame` pattern for guaranteed paint flush; not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted 3 temporary GEM goals (Chronic Thyroid, Daily Meditation, Run Marathon) under admin@test.com during E2E testing. All cleaned up via DELETE /api/gem/goals/{id}.

Live preview was serving a stale Metro bundle until expo was restarted via supervisor — keep this in mind: if a fix looks like it's not applied, check the bundle text first (curl the entry.bundle URL and grep for the new string) before re-debugging the source code.
rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL RCA (recap, confirmed): (a) pna.tsx pushed `/tools/gem-goal?goal_id=...` but gem-goal.tsx reads `id` via useLocalSearchParams, so editId was undefined and loadGoal() never executed -> defaults (goalType=aspiration) shown. (b) Open icon onPress only navigated without closing modal -> stacked overlay. (c) handleCreateGemGoal previously mapped category->goal_type via project/objective/aspiration vocabulary, so PNA-created GEM goals stored 'project' for problems and 'objective' for needs, which no longer matched the chip ids. FIXES SHIPPED: openLinkedGoal helper now closes modal then pushes `?id=`; goal_type is sent as the canonical category; gem-goal.tsx loadGoal applies a typeMap to map legacy values to canonical ones. VERIFICATION: All 3 categories Problem/Need/Aspiration round-trip correctly through PNA create -> GEM goal page pre-populated with matching chip highlighted; backend POST/GET on /api/gem/goals returns goal_type unchanged for all 3 canonical values.
